name: Giorgia Meloni
role: Prime Minister of Italy (2022–present); leader of Fratelli d'Italia (2014–present)
summary: Meloni leads a national-conservative party and champions family, national identity, border control and a Western alliance (NATO, support for Ukraine), while promoting a "Europe of homelands" over deeper EU integration. She favours tax cuts, replacing the citizen's income with work and training, and a directly elected executive.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Programme she led keeps and strengthens the public health service (waiting lists, extending essential care levels to dental care) and proposes no shift to private insurance.

property-fundamental.rationale: Programme promises protection of private property, immediate eviction of squatters and an unseizable first home.

cut-welfare.rationale: Abolished the citizen's income for able-bodied people, calling it a defeat for them, but promises higher pensions and support for the fragile; evidence points both ways.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Says those able to work should be offered work, training and job placement instead of the citizen's income, while support continues for those who cannot work.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Programme favours workers' participation in company profits and governance; no vote on running large firms is specified.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Programme proposes "tariffs of civilisation" on imports from non-EU states that ignore environmental standards and incentives to relocate production to Italy.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Programme calls for restoring an industrial strategy, secure supply chains in strategic sectors and use of golden-power screening.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Programme extends the flat tax for self-employed up to 100,000 euro and introduces a flat tax on income increases, aiming to widen it for families and firms.

cut-consumption-tax.rationale: Programme extends reduced VAT to the grocery basket and infant goods and promises automatic VAT and excise cuts on energy and fuel.

school-vouchers.rationale: Programme promises school-choice freedom for families including vouchers spendable at any school.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Programme backs wider application of national collective agreements and second-level bargaining to secure fair pay.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: Programme commits to protecting strategic companies through proper use of golden power.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Programme backs common EU defence, yet she favours a "Europe of homelands" and rejects deeper integration for its own sake; evidence points both ways.

nation-first.rationale: Programme centres foreign policy on defending the national interest, though she also stresses being a reliable ally.

traditional-family.rationale: Programme calls the family the founding community of society and a sacred good; in her memoir she lists the family among things under attack.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Programme keeps only the civil-unions law and bans same-sex adoption; Wikipedia reports she opposes same-sex marriage.

abortion-legal.rationale: Says she would not change Law 194 and wants its prevention part fully applied, while opposing abortion and promising to protect life from its beginning.

more-religion-public.rationale: Describes herself publicly as Christian and defends religious identity as under attack; programme defends Judeo-Christian roots.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Reported as sceptical of "gender ideology", which she says attacks female identity.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Programme calls for defence of Italian identity, culture and symbols and a fight against cancel culture; memoir stresses defending identity.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Wants to stop illegal arrivals, but her government issued large legal work-permit quotas and she says legal immigration is needed.

open-borders.rationale: Programme calls for defending national and EU borders, border controls and stopping landings.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Reported as opposed to birthright (territorial) citizenship proposals for foreigners born in Italy.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: She called "surreal" an EU Commission case over a social policy favouring Italians over recent non-citizen immigrants.

elite-replacement.rationale: Reported to have used "ethnic substitution" language (2017, 2019 book) and described pro-immigration policy as left-wing replacement; as PM she has said Italy needs legal immigration. Contested.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: Programme raises child allowances, income-splitting and tax cuts for births; she wants higher native births to ease the need for migrant labour.

patriotic-education.rationale: Programme promotes teaching the history of Italy's great figures in schools and defending Italian symbols.

history-own-civilization.rationale: Programme promotes, especially in schools, the history of the greats of Italy.

preserve-contested-monuments.rationale: Programme opposes cancel culture and iconoclasm threatening symbols of national identity.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: In her inaugural speech she condemned the 20th-century totalitarianisms together, saying horrors and crimes from anyone are not justified.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Pledged to fight every form of racism, antisemitism and discrimination; programme opposes discrimination, though it bars same-sex adoption.

gender-equality-agencies.rationale: Programme proposes an authority to guarantee pay transparency and close the gender pay gap.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: Programme toughens penalties for crimes against animals and recognises the role of companion animals.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: Programme calls it a duty to protect and enhance the inherited cultural heritage.

class-collaboration.rationale: Programme calls entrepreneurs a resource, not an enemy, and favours worker participation in profits and governance.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: Programme calls for presidential reform and direct citizen link to government leadership; her government later proposed direct election of the prime minister.

strong-leader.rationale: Argues government instability is a main cause of decline and that presidentialism is the best economic measure; seeks stable governments.

proportional-representation.rationale: Her premierato reform pairs direct election of the PM with an electoral law giving the winning coalition 55 percent of seats.

decide-locally.rationale: Government passed differentiated autonomy for regions (2024), while the programme pairs autonomy with national unity.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Says recent governments were palace games distant from voters' wishes and a political class neglected the national interest.

democracy-best.rationale: Says liberty and democracy are what she identifies with, rejects the drift by which democracy is for some and less for others, and defends the voters' choice against outside "vigilance".

consent-of-governed.rationale: Stresses popular sovereignty and a government representing the popular will.

empower-police-military.rationale: Programme promises more staff, equipment and legal protection for police, fire service and armed forces.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Programme promises to fight drug dealing and use by every means; her government's security bill banned cannabis in any form.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Reported as opposing the Mancino hate-speech law and the Zan bill, though she pledges to fight racism and antisemitism.

rehabilitation.rationale: Programme stresses certainty of punishment and rejects measures to empty prisons.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Programme adds a prisons plan and more police and prison staff.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Programme opposes any discrimination based on sexual choices and keeps the civil-unions law.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Visited Yad Vashem as minister, calls the 1938 racial laws a shame, and pledges maximum intransigence against antisemitism.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Calls the 1938 racial laws the lowest point of Italian history and pledges to fight racism.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Told the Chamber she finds opposition criticism useful and respects political opponents.

one-party-rule.rationale: Governs through a multiparty coalition and defends pluralist democracy and legitimate opposition.

total-state.rationale: Programme complains of an ever more invasive state, disrespectful of citizens' and firms' liberties.

collective-defense.rationale: Calls Italy a reliable partner in NATO and promises full respect of alliances and defence spending to NATO levels.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Programme and speech commit to full respect for NATO and EU alliances.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Programme calls Italy's Western placement a natural choice and backs Ukraine alongside allies.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Programme promises research investment in next-generation nuclear power.

close-ties-china.rationale: Described as a critic of China; programme rejects the Chinese social-credit model and affirms the Western alignment.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Said Russia's annexation of four Ukrainian provinces has no legal or political value and backs Ukraine's territorial integrity.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Denounces "ultra-ecological fanaticism" and criticised the EU 2035 combustion-car ban, while backing decarbonisation "with common sense".

limit-growth.rationale: Programme says environment and economic growth are complementary, not opposed.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Told parliament Italy has a duty to exploit its seas' gas fields fully; government made new drilling decisions.

future-generations.rationale: Programme says that without caring for the environment we cannot save ourselves and our children.

political-violence-never.rationale: Pledged to fight all political violence and said crimes from anyone are not justified.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Says such matters are handled with a pragmatic, not ideological, approach; programme says rights prevail over ideological visions.

notes: Her EU and euro stance moved from exit rhetoric to working within the EU; common-currency left null because no clear recent statement was found in the sources read. Several positions (social issues, replacement language, Gaza/Israel) come from Wikipedia only and were answered low or left null; the Wikipedia Gaza passage is internally inconsistent (arms embargo versus pro-Israel), so Israel statements are null. Not retrieved: governo.it speech text, Vox/CPAC speeches, full memoir, Albania/surrogacy primary texts.
